name: Hotel Efteling
description: The flagship 4-star hotel at Efteling, beautifully themed around the park fairy tale world. Located within the resort with direct park access and early entry included.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Elegantly themed room for up to 4 guests with fairy tale decor.

rooms.name: Fairy Tale Suite
rooms.description: Luxurious suite with immersive storybook theming and extra space for families.

name: Landal Efteling
description: A beautiful holiday village of themed cottages and villas set in the forest adjacent to Efteling. Ideal for families wanting a self-catering resort experience.

rooms.name: Forest Cottage
rooms.description: Charming self-catering cottage for up to 4 guests nestled among the trees.

rooms.name: Family Villa
rooms.description: Spacious villa sleeping up to 8 guests with full kitchen and private terrace.

name: Efteling Loonsche Land
description: A unique glamping and lodge resort inspired by the Loonsche Land area of Efteling. Features beautifully designed safari tents and woodland lodges for an unforgettable nature stay.

rooms.name: Safari Tent
rooms.description: Furnished glamping tent for up to 5 guests with heating and private outdoor area.

rooms.name: Woodland Lodge
rooms.description: Cosy lodge sleeping up to 6 guests surrounded by forest with a hot tub.
